home.title: Events
home.empty: Events you create or join show here. Open a link from the host, or create one.

todo.title: Needs you
todo.who: Pick your name to see what needs you

me.label: Who are you?
me.isThisYou: "{name}" is already on the list. Is that you?
me.linkHint: Open this link on your other phone or computer to be you there too. Keep it to yourself: anyone with it can act as you.
me.otherDevice: Used the app before? Pick your name from the list and enter your PIN.
me.claimedName: "{name}" is already taken. If that is you, open your sign-in link from your old device, or ask an organizer to reset your PIN.
me.signOutConfirm: You can sign back in with your name and PIN. Organizer links opened on this device are forgotten too.
me.noneToPick: No names left to pick. If you have used the app before, open your sign-in link or ask an organizer to reset your PIN.
me.signOutNoPin: Set a PIN first, or copy your sign-in link: without one of them you cannot sign back in as yourself. Organizer links opened on this device are forgotten too.
me.noPinNudge: Set a 6-digit PIN so you can sign in on any phone or computer.
me.otherDeviceNew: Already have a name? Sign in from the account menu in the sidebar with your name and PIN.
me.signOutOthersConfirm: Every other device where you are signed in will be signed out, and your old sign-in link stops working. This device stays signed in. Your PIN does not change.
me.othersOutHint: The old sign-in link no longer works. Copy the new one if you need it.

event.private: This event doesn't exist or is private. Ask the host for the joining link.

create.title: New event
create.name: Event name
create.pollVenueHint: Everyone can suggest and upvote venues.
create.bankHint: Optional, used for the VietQR code
create.needDays: Pick at least one day to vote on.
create.paymentLater: You can add these later, when the bill comes in.
create.bankPublic: Bank details are visible to anyone who has the event link.
create.fixedDateNoVenue: You have a date but no place yet: the event opens with a vote on the place first, and people RSVP once you lock it.

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.guestsHint: Adding guests moves you to the back of the queue if seats are full.
rsvp.fromVote: Counted as going from your votes. Change your answer if you can't make it.
rsvp.held: The plan changed. Your seat is held until {deadline}. Confirm to keep it.
rsvp.released: Your held seat was released. You can still join.
rsvp.guestsQueue: Adding guests puts you at the back of the queue.

manage.linkHint: Anyone with this link can manage the event. Only share it with co-organizers.

err.generic: Something went wrong, please try again.
err.organizersOnly: Only people who have created an event can do this.
err.nameTaken: That name is already on the list.
err.invalidDate: Pick a date and time (or days to poll).
err.invalidLink: Links must start with http:// or https://
err.invalidCover: Pick a cover or paste an image link starting with https://
err.notYou: You can only change your own answers.
err.hostOnly: Only the host can do that.
err.venueExists: That place is already on the list.
err.daysRequired: Keep at least one day in the poll.
err.tooManyCohosts: An event can have at most 5 co-hosts, including pending invites.
err.alreadyCohost: This person is already a co-host.
err.inviteInvalid: This invite is no longer valid. Ask the host for a new one.
err.inviteExpired: This invite has expired. Ask the host for a new one.
err.hasPayments: Payments were already recorded. Confirm that you want to keep them.
err.notStarted: The event has not started yet.
err.planFrozen: The date and place are fixed once the event has started. Use "Correct date or place".
err.notAttending: Only people with a seat at this event pay a share.
err.startsInPast: That time has already passed. Pick a time in the future.
err.signInFirst: Tell us who you are first.
err.nameClaimed: Someone already signed in with that name. Use your sign-in link instead.
err.nameOrganizer: This name organizes an event, so it can't be picked from the list. Open your sign-in link or manage link instead.
err.signInInvalid: This sign-in link is not valid.
err.keyChanged: The manage link was just changed. Reload the page and try again.
err.manageKeyRequired: Open the event with its current manage link to change the manage link.
err.pinWeak: That PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid repeated digits and runs like 123456.
err.pinLocked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in 15 minutes, or ask an organizer to reset your PIN.
err.pinResetOrganizer: This member organizes events, so their PIN can only be changed by themselves.

days.title: Edit days
days.description: Add or remove the days people can vote on.
days.willLose: Removing it deletes the votes of {names}.
days.confirmTitle: {n} vote will be deleted | {n} votes will be deleted
days.confirmBody: They can't be restored. These people will need to vote again.

poll.noVenues: Suggest the first one for everyone to vote on.
poll.tapHint: Tap the days you can make
poll.pickName: Pick your name above to vote
poll.dup: Already on the list. We added your vote.
poll.removeBody: {n} vote for it will be removed too. | {n} votes for it will be removed too.
poll.closedCancelled: Voting closed: the event was cancelled
poll.daysHint: Tick every day you could make it. If one of your days is picked, you're counted as going.
poll.venuesHint: Vote for the places you like, or suggest another.

bill.title: Bill
bill.pending: The organizer hasn't entered the bill yet.
bill.rounded: split across {n} seats, rounded up to 1,000 ₫
bill.noBank: No bank account set, pay the organizer directly.
bill.locked: This event is completed, so payments are locked.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.pollDays: {n} day to vote on | {n} days to vote on

team.hint: Archive people who no longer take part. They leave the name list and the "no reply yet" counts, and come back when they sign in again.

settings.title: Appearance
settings.description: Choose how the app looks for you.
settings.mainStyleHint: Used on the home list, calendar and new events. An event can still have its own theme.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: How this event looks to everyone
theme.previewHint: See a sample event in each theme before you choose.

who.title: First, who are you?
who.link: Is this you? Pick your name
who.body: Pick your name or enter a new one so your votes count.

vote.title: You haven't voted yet
vote.body: Pick the days you can make below.

voted.title: Thanks for voting!
voted.body: {n} people have voted so far. If your days win, you're counted as going. The organizer will lock the result.

declined.title: Sad to miss you this time
declined.body: You won't be counted as going. Changed your mind? Pick days again any time before voting closes.

waitlist.title: You're #{place} on the waitlist
waitlist.body: You'll move up automatically if a seat frees up.

replied.title: Thanks for replying
replied.body: You can change your answer until the organizer closes RSVP.

pay.title: You owe {amount}
pay.body: Scan the QR code below or pay the organizer.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Nothing needed from you right now.

settled.title: 🎉 All settled, thanks everyone!
settled.body: Hope it was a great one.

next.lockHint: Everyone who voted for this day counts as going, in the order they voted; past the seat limit they wait. Everyone else can reply Going, Maybe or Can't make it.

voteVenue.title: You haven't voted yet
voteVenue.body: Pick the places you like below, or suggest another.

voteClosed.title: Voting is closed
voteClosed.body: Waiting for {host} to pick the date.
voteClosed.bodyHost: Pick the winning day and place.

next.tie: It's a tie for first. Pick one.
next.closeBody: Participants can't change their votes any more. Organizers still can, every vote is kept, and you can reopen voting later.
next.reopenBody: Every vote is kept. The earlier deadline is replaced by the choice below.

consequences.rsvp: Everyone else can answer Going, Maybe or Can't make it
consequences.kept: Votes are kept if the host reopens voting

next.lockWaiting: {n} person waits for a seat: {names} | {n} people wait for a seat: {names}
next.lockConfirm: {n} voter is asked to confirm | {n} voters are asked to confirm

confirm.title: Can you make it?
confirm.body: The plan is set: {when}. Let us know if you're coming.

reconfirmHeld.title: The plan changed
reconfirmHeld.body: The plan changed to {when}. Your seat is held until {deadline}.

goingAuto.title: You're in, from your vote 🎉
goingAuto.body: See you {when}. Change your answer below if you can't make it.

completedOpen.title: Completed, a few payments are still open
completedOpen.body: Thanks everyone. Payments can still be reported.

next.completeFreeBody: Nobody will be asked to pay.
next.completeAnywayBody: These people still owe. They can keep paying after the event is completed.
next.allAnswered: Everyone has replied. Lock it now?
next.closeVsLock: Close voting: stop taking votes, nothing is decided. Lock: pick the day (and place); everyone who voted for it counts as going. At the deadline, voting closes by itself and waits for you to lock.
next.billAfter: You can enter the bill once the event starts ({when}).
next.lockOnly: Voting is closed. Lock to pick the day (and place); everyone who voted for it counts as going.

edit.title: Edit event
edit.description: Changes take effect for everyone when you save.
edit.deadlineHint: Optional. After it, only organizers can change votes.
edit.cohostRotateConfirm: The current co-host link will stop working. Continue?
edit.cancelledNote: This event is cancelled. Restore it to edit.
edit.discardBody: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they're lost.
edit.noAccess: You no longer have organizer access
edit.noAccessHint: Your edits are still here. Close this panel to refresh the page.
edit.votingClosed: Voting is closed. Reopen it from the event page.
edit.capWaitlist: {n} person moves to the waitlist | {n} people move to the waitlist
edit.capPromote: {n} person gets a seat | {n} people get a seat
edit.billHint: Correcting the total changes what everyone owes.
edit.shareChangeHint: Everyone's remaining amount is recalculated from what they have already paid.
edit.endsPlaceVote: Setting a place ends the place vote ({n} suggestion) | Setting a place ends the place vote ({n} suggestions)
edit.postUpdateHint: Tell everyone what changed. It shows at the top of the event when you save.
edit.rederive: {n} stay going · {m} seats held until they confirm
edit.released: {n} hold already expired and stays released | {n} holds already expired and stay released
edit.planFrozen: The event has started, so the date and place are fixed.
edit.honoreesHint: Each day shows whether they can come

share.dialogHint: Only people with this link can see and join. Scan the code or send the link.
share.qrAlt: QR code for the event link
share.messageCopied: Message copied, ready to paste into Zalo

notice.reconfirm: If you were counted from your vote, please confirm by {deadline} or your seat is released.

host.reopenBody: Move the event back? Votes and answers are kept, but the stage changes for everyone.
host.cancelBody: Everyone will see this event as cancelled. You can restore it later.
host.deleteBody: Delete for good? This removes all votes and payments and cannot be undone.
host.reopenDerived: {n} answer counted from votes is cleared. | {n} answers counted from votes are cleared.
host.reopenPayments: Payments are kept, they are not cleared:
host.reopenAck: I know these payments stay recorded

org.title: Organizers
org.description: Who can manage this event, and what each role can do.

rows.answer: Vote, RSVP and pay for themselves
rows.advance: Lock the date, enter the bill, settle
rows.setOthers: Change other people's RSVP and payments
rows.cancel: Cancel, restore or delete the event
rows.cohost: Manage the manage link and the co-host link

org.trust: Names are labels the host chose, not verified identities: there is no login. Anyone who opens an invite link first can accept it, so send it privately. Don't use co-host access on a shared computer.
org.reissueConfirm: Their current access stops now, until they accept the new link.
org.revokeConfirm: They lose co-host access right away.
org.leaveConfirm: You will no longer be able to manage this event.
org.inviteHint: Shown once. Send it privately; whoever opens it first can accept. It works once and expires in 7 days.
org.legacyHint: The older link anyone could use. It can be revoked here but not created again; invite co-hosts by name instead.
org.rotateConfirm: The current manage link stops working everywhere. Copy the new one afterwards if you need to manage the event from another device.
org.rotatedHint: Old manage links no longer work.

post.title: Post an update
post.body: Everyone will see this at the top of the event right away.

overview.title: Overview
overview.seatLimit: Seat limit: {cap}. Seats go first come, first served.

invite.title: You are invited to co-host as {name}
invite.body: As a co-host you can edit the event, lock the date, enter the bill and settle. You can leave any time.
invite.notYou: This invite is for {name}. If that is you, choose your name first.
invite.invalid: This invite is no longer valid. Ask the host for a new one.
invite.expired: It expired. Ask the host for a new one.

correct.title: Correct date or place
correct.body: Attendance and payments are not changed.

compare.title: Compare the leading days
compare.tieHonorees: Tied at {n} votes. {day} is suggested because more honorees can come.
compare.tieEarlier: Tied at {n} votes. {day} is only a tentative pick because it is earlier, not because more people can come; check who can make each day below.

keep.title: Set a PIN to keep your access
keep.subtitle: So you can get back in from any phone or computer.
keep.body: {name}, you have no PIN yet. Without one, only your sign-in link brings you back with your organizer rights. Choose a 6-digit PIN now.
keep.linkInstead: Or save your sign-in link to yourself (for example Zalo “My Cloud”) and never post it in a group.
keep.manual: Copy did not work. Select and copy the link below:

pin.label: PIN
pin.chooseFor: {name} has no PIN yet. Choose one to sign in as {name}.
pin.hintEnter: Forgot it? Ask an organizer to reset it.
pin.hintNew: You will use it to sign in on any device. Avoid 123456 or 111111.
pin.weak: Too easy to guess. Avoid repeated digits and runs like 123456.
pin.resetDone: New PIN for {name}: {pin}. Pass it on privately: it is shown only once, and they are signed out everywhere.
